warnings: CORRECTED BY MAKHAM 2026-08-24. The first extraction read this as an 11.00m x 11.00m perimeter ring beam offset 1.50m outside the column grid, landing on dummy grids 1'/3'/A'/C'. That is wrong. RB1 sits EXACTLY ON the main 8x8 column grid: every RB1 run is 8.00m (A1-A3, A1-C1, A3-C3, C1-C3), each drawn as two 4.00m segments with a column at all three intersections, and every tie_beam endpoint on this sheet lands on a main grid intersection — no prime appears anywhere on the sheet. What misled the first pass is the DASHED rectangle 1.50m outside the columns: that is the roof-overhang/eave outline, and the four 'โล่ง' diagonals run from the RB1 corners out to ITS corners, which made the overhang look like the beam perimeter. Per §329 (do not invent a dummy for a roof-overhang or eave edge with no beam label and no columns at its corners) the overhang gets no dummy grid on this sheet. The printed 1.50/4.00/4.00/1.50 chain on this page dimensions the overhang, not a beam line — it stays in dimension_chains as a chain and no longer justifies any dummy grid.

Unchanged by the correction above: the inner cross tie RB2 runs along the main grid centerlines (x=2, y=B) from the perimeter in to a single central steel king post P1 at grid B2 — directly above column C2. P1 receives the roof ridge/hip apex load and transfers it straight down through column C2 to footing F10 at B2. All four RB2 arms were already recorded on main grid intersections at 4.00m and were correct.

KNOCK-ON, RESOLVED 2026-08-24 — the grid master's four outer dummy lines were each justified by this sheet's misread ring beam, so all four of those justifications went void. All four lines survive on other evidence. The 1.50m offset itself is real, it just belongs to the ROOF FRAME rather than to RB1: S-05 (หน้า28) draws the roof frame's solid outline at 1.50m on all four sides and runs the steel fascia 'เชิงชายเหล็ก (โดยรอบ)' continuously around it, so 1'/3'/A'/C' all carry that member. Three of them are additionally carried by FLOOR-level beams on S-03/หน้า26, confirmed by pixel scan: 1'(-1.50) has B6 with B6X/BX at its south end; 3'(+9.50) has the east bay's outer run, solid and unbroken from the north strip down to row C; C'(+9.50) has the ramp/deck beam B5. A'(-1.50) is roof-frame-only, which is legitimate — it is not orphaned. AN EARLIER VERSION OF THIS WARNING SAID A' HAD NOTHING ON IT AND SHOULD BE DELETED; that was written off a scan of หน้า26 alone, before หน้า28 was opened, and is retracted. Separately the A-axis did gain a new line and a renumber, but for an unrelated reason — a floor-level beam at -1.00 north of row A, see the grid master and หน้า26.

Four diagonal lines cross the plan from each RB1 corner toward the center — these are explicitly labeled 'โล่ง' (open/void) on the sheet itself, i.e. they are roof-slope indication lines only, NOT a beam mark. No element was created for them here; the corresponding real structural members (steel hip rafters, ตะเข้สันเหล็ก) are recorded on the roof-frame plan (S-05, หน้า28) instead.

A callout on this sheet points to a separate expanded detail for P1's base ('ดูแบบขยายฐานรับเสาตั้งเหล็ก (P1) รับโครงหลังคา') — that detail is on S-07 (หน้า30, view3), not on this sheet; P1's steel_section spec is joined in from there and from S-07's own note 'P1 = ดั้งเหล็ก 2⌐-150x50x20x3.2มม.'.
